test_build_image_get_entrypoint_commands: test the build_image._get_entrypoint_commands function to verify it appends the correct suffix to entrypoint commands
test_build_image_no_duplicate_suffix: test that _get_entrypoint_commands does not duplicate existing $@ or "$@" suffixes in command lists
test_build_image_single_quoted_suffix: test that _get_entrypoint_commands appends "$@" when the command already contains single-quoted '$@'
test_build_image_python_container_entryp: test creating an xm.PythonContainer with an entrypoint and verifying build_image processes it correctly
test_build_image_module_name_entrypoint: test that _get_entrypoint_commands handles xm.ModuleName entrypoints and adds the proper suffix
